analysis:
This pass covered three documentation-only units of docs/provider/cli-reference.md: base lines 2817-3187 and head lines 1-363. The visible head changes are limited to two subcommand-table rows.

Head line 182 adds that `sandbox setup` requires approval from the Darkbloom Sandbox waitlist. That text describes a gate in front of TB-013/T-061, the installer that runs as the Mac owner. It is not a weaker control. The documentation gives no evidence on how the approval is enforced, whether server-side or in the CLI. An approval gate is not integrity protection for install.sh, so T-061's installer-integrity mitigations still apply. Integration should check that SandboxCommand.swift does not treat waitlist approval as a substitute for installer verification. It should also check that the coordinator response cannot redirect the installer download.

Head line 191 adds a `waitlist` command (Waitlist/WaitlistCommand.swift). It lists or joins per-account waitlists through the coordinator and accepts `--config`. Under ADV-003, an outbound authenticated account call is a small new surface. The token handling in that path (A-008) is not visible here.

The file_changes map also shows changed head ranges 1360-1385, 1404, 1427, 1475-1485 and 1635-1727. Those ranges are not in these units, so they are not reviewed here and are a coverage gap.

No security-control semantics visible in this batch weaken the prefix-cache documentation for T-041. That includes the LaunchAgent passthrough of DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE and the disk/write-budget settings. They also do not weaken the App Attest worker opt-in (TB-011) or the coordinator URL binding.

No concrete regression was identified in the reviewed text.
